'''Vault 806''' was the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] designation for one of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] vaults in the [[Caves of the Primeval Wardens]], a section of [[the Tomb]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. During the [[invasion of Belsavis]], the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Ivory]] attempted to escape Belsavis using a Rakata [[Starship/Legends|ship]] stored in the vault, but was pursued by a [[Voidhound|smuggler]] and the [[Abyssin/Legends|Abyssin]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Dust (Abyssin)|Dust]]. After the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] and Ivory killed Dust, Ivory agreed to work with the smuggler to take down his former protege [[Rogun Matt'rik]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vault 806 appears in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as the location of the Smuggler class mission "Twenty to Life" on Belsavis.<ref name="TOR" />
